'''Skeleton bone throwers''' are summoned by [[Zemouregal]] to aid him during [[The World Wakes]]. They, like the [[ghostly wraith]]s and [[armoured zombie]]s that Zemouregal also summons, are extremely weak and easily able to be defeated.

==Update history==
{{UH|
* {{UL|type=patch|update=Unwelcome Guests Slayer Content - This Week In RuneScape|date=11 April 2023}}
** Can be killed as part of the new undead slayer task.

* {{UL|type=update|update=The World Wakes|date=4 March 2013}}
** Added to game.
}}

==Trivia==
*Despite their name, they actually throw rocks instead of bones.
